**What it is:**  
A Python CLI that generates 7-day NCLEX-PN remediation study plans from missed-question tags. Reads local JSON files (`seed/missed.json`, `journal.json`), schedules review across topics/client needs intelligently, outputs text/JSON/plain formats. Fully local, standard library only—designed to open in a text editor on your phone if needed.
